name: Location
title: Location
description: One row per Location, with no geometry: its parent (partOf), its type code, whether it is an administrative unit and its administrative code. The constants are the project-specific parts: admin_unit_type is the type code that marks an administrative unit, and admin_code_system is the identifier system that holds the administrative code. fhir-pipes reads the first of a list of identifier systems; this view reads one, so the two differ only when a Location carries the code under a second system. LocationHierarchy depends on this view.
